paragraphs.source_en: Again I was jolted awake from sleep— by the pipa in the dead of night. Whose sadness is this, whose fingers, like a chill wind, like a cruel rain, like blossoms falling, in this deepest hour of night, in this drowsy half-sleep, they pluck and prod the taut strings, wildly striking the tones of gong, shang, jiao, zhi, matching this midnight, this desolate street, at the tips of the willows hangs a half moon, Ah, a half moon—like broken hope—he, wears a flowered hat, and has iron chains upon him, on the path of time he dances like one gone mad, he laughs like one gone mad, At last, he says: "Blow out your lamp." She waits on the far side of the grave, waiting for you to come and kiss, waiting for you to come and kiss, waiting for you to come and kiss!

units.source_zh:
是誰的悲思，

是誰的手指，

像一陣凄風，像一陣慘雨，像一陣落花，

在這夜深深時，

在這睡昏昏時，

挑動著緊促的弦索，亂彈著宮商角徵，

和著這深夜，荒街，

柳梢頭有殘月掛，

啊，半輪的殘月，像是破碎的希望他，他

頭戴一頂開花帽，

身上帶著鐵鏈條，

在光陰的道上瘋了似的跳，瘋了似的笑，

完了，他說，吹糊你的燈，

她在墳墓的那一邊等，

等你去親吻，等你去親吻，等你去親吻！
